method: AUDIT IN -> FINDINGS -> REMEDIATION -> VERIFICATION -> AUDIT OUT

layers.name: Frontend foundations
evidence: Candidate 1608968 retains the tested desktop/mobile first-use UI and adds native radio semantics plus roving keyboard focus for onboarding choices. The complete release gate passed, and the final Preview uses the same verified concierge asset hashes with fail-closed sign-in.
layers.testCommand: npm run release:gate && npm run test:concierge
layers.failureDetails: A full automated WCAG/Lighthouse artifact, signed-user flow, and Production behavior remain unknown.
layers.remediation: Capture a full automated accessibility and performance artifact, then repeat bounded route, console, responsive, and signed-user checks after Production approval.

layers.name: APIs and backend logic
evidence: API security, resilience, idempotency, output-boundary, and serverless import tests pass locally across 41 routes. Exact candidate 1aded9c on protected Preview dpl_E2D1cHiTdHg9Si2qhc1frrYpe1qW returned liveness 200, readiness 503 fail-closed, app configuration 200, and three bounded discovery-canary 200s. Each canary attempted and completed eight representative sources across all four ATS providers out of the 37-source catalog in 1.406-1.718 seconds. Production is not the candidate artifact.
layers.testCommand: npm run test:web-release && npm run security:live-boundary
layers.failureDetails: Production is not the candidate artifact and signed-user behavior remains unknown.
layers.remediation: Configure an isolated signed-beta environment, run safe signed-user Preview probes, and repeat complete bounded Production acceptance only after release approval.

layers.name: Database and storage
evidence: Static inventory verifies one CLI-generated canonical migration reconciled from three reviewed sources, 20 source tables with RLS and forced RLS, explicit client-role revokes, operation-specific backend policies, no destructive statements, and zero non-tenant-scoped references. Candidate 39d28c9 adds a strict value-free live-target evidence contract bound to the clean release, canonical migration, target/Production separation, 20-table runtime surface, grants/policies, all 19 pgTAP cases, and advisors. The Supabase account still has two unrelated active projects, zero branches, zero eligible 1stStep.ai targets, and an occupied Free allocation; no database was connected or modified.
layers.testCommand: npm run test:database-evidence && npm run security:isolated-data-preflight
layers.failureDetails: No isolated target was proven. Applied history, drift, runtime grants, tenant denial, advisor results, backup/PITR policy, private object storage, restore integrity, RPO, and RTO remain unknown.
layers.remediation: Select the organization and authorize an exact cost lookup, or approve a local-runtime installation path; then choose the new-project or paid data-less branch route, separately authorize creation and migration, pass the runtime evidence contract, verify private object storage, and complete a separately authorized restore drill.

layers.name: Authentication and permissions
evidence: Opaque signed-session, revocation, tenant ownership, admin-role, entitlement, and consent tests pass locally. Exact Preview dpl_E2D1cHiTdHg9Si2qhc1frrYpe1qW verified a server-only readiness check exposes only restoreAccessAvailable=false. A value-blind Production audit found zero of five consent-control names and zero of eight controlled-beta names present; actual values and signed-user behavior remain unavailable and unclaimed.
layers.testCommand: node scripts/user-session-test.mjs && node scripts/api-security-test.mjs && node scripts/clerk-identity-test.mjs && node scripts/app-config-test.mjs
layers.failureDetails: Actual signed-user creation/revocation, identity-provider configuration, and cross-tenant staging behavior remain unverified.
layers.remediation: Configure the isolated signed-beta runtime, then verify a least-privilege staging account matrix, email-code session creation, revocation, admin denial, and tenant-crossing denial using synthetic accounts and the exact release commit.

layers.name: Hosting and deployment
evidence: Clean release candidate 39d28c9 passed the complete release gate and clean-candidate preflight. Exact protected Preview dpl_AiGJMf7zBkHJbwv6CjFtZvNj8STf verified route behavior, the representative discovery canary, bounded capacity behavior, and content-free provider logs. Fresh Production parity still fails for the four concierge artifacts and Production lacks the candidate health routes.
layers.testCommand: npm run release:gate && npm run test:deployment-output && npm run security:asset-parity
layers.failureDetails: Production serves a different artifact and remote CI for the candidate is unknown.
layers.remediation: Push the reviewed candidate, require green remote CI, resolve Critical infrastructure gates, then obtain explicit Production approval before promotion and bounded acceptance checks.

layers.name: Cloud and compute
evidence: Function durations, fail-closed feature flags, spend limits, bounded concurrency, and isolated-worker contracts pass locally. Exact account/project inspection confirms an active Pro plan, Node 24.x, iad1 function/default region, Fluid Compute, and a standard fixed build machine. Candidate 1aded9c retains the regression-checked 45-second signed-user discovery ceiling; three exact-Preview canaries completed inside the function in 1.406-1.718 seconds. A value-blind Production audit found all seven durable-runtime names but only 14 of 24 cost-control names; values and runtime behavior are not inferred.
layers.testCommand: npm run test:resilience && node scripts/public-ats-discovery-test.mjs && node scripts/job-agent-worker-api-test.mjs
layers.failureDetails: Function/account quota ceilings, approved cost ceilings, cold starts, signed-user saturation, and vendor failure behavior remain unknown.
layers.remediation: Approve explicit function/account quota, queue, latency, and cost ceilings, then perform bounded signed-user dependency-failure and saturation exercises.

layers.name: CI/CD and version control
evidence: Implementation commit 307e48d hardens the Node 24 workflows with SHA-pinned actions, locked installs, bounded jobs, minimal permissions, concurrency controls, and non-persisted checkout credentials. Commit 0510756 adds a separate bounded high/critical production dependency-audit job. The local CI policy test and complete release gate pass; npm audit found zero vulnerabilities across 167 production dependencies (181 total dependency entries).
layers.testCommand: npm run test:ci-policy && npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high && npm run release:gate
layers.failureDetails: The hardened workflow and dependency audit have not yet executed in GitHub because push and review were not authorized.
layers.remediation: Obtain explicit push and review authorization, require both Production Readiness Gate jobs as branch checks, and verify the remote CI results before release review.

layers.name: Security and row-level security
evidence: Static checks verify forced RLS intent, explicit client-role/PUBLIC revocation, backend-only operation policies, composite tenant constraints, no user_metadata authorization reference, and no service-role marker in the browser bundle. Candidate 39d28c9 adds a strict runtime verifier requiring forced RLS on all 20 tables, a non-login/non-bypass backend role, zero client-role privilege leaks, operation-specific policies, all 19 adversarial pgTAP cases, clean advisors, exact release identity, and a target distinct from Production. No live target has run it.
layers.failureDetails: Applied runtime grants, Data API exposure, policy evaluation for anon/authenticated/backend roles, adversarial cross-tenant denial, advisors, and live service-role boundaries remain unverified.
layers.remediation: Pass the protected isolated-target preflight, separately authorize the audit/migration, then run the catalog/grant inspection, pgTAP, and advisors and validate the redacted artifact.

layers.name: Rate limiting
evidence: Durable tenant/global rate limits, hashed partitions, fail-closed configuration, and local regression tests exist; a prior operator round trip proved Upstash reachability but current parity was not rechecked.
layers.failureDetails: Current deployed limits, alert thresholds, and behavior under concurrent tenants are not verified.
layers.remediation: Run an approved staging concurrency test and a bounded production readiness probe that records only aggregate decisions and latency.

layers.name: Caching and CDN
evidence: Preview verified concierge and API Cache-Control no-store, strict concierge CSP/security headers, and homepage public max-age=300 with stale-while-revalidate=60.
layers.failureDetails: Production headers, invalidation behavior, error-route caching, and authenticated cross-user cache isolation remain unknown.
layers.remediation: Repeat header checks after production approval and add signed-user cache-isolation and error-route scenarios.

layers.name: Load balancing and scaling
evidence: Discovery work is concurrency bounded and provider circuit breakers isolate failing sources. Exact protected Preview dpl_E2D1cHiTdHg9Si2qhc1frrYpe1qW on the confirmed Pro/Fluid/iad1 runtime passed a GET-only, body-free authenticated CLI probe: 10/10 HTTP 200 at concurrency 2, p50 112 ms and p95/max 129 ms, with no bypass secret or writes. The representative discovery canary returned 3/3 HTTP 200 with truthful source counts.
layers.testCommand: node scripts/public-ats-discovery-test.mjs && npm run test:resilience && npm run test:capacity-probe
layers.failureDetails: Quota and cost ceilings, signed-user fairness, queue throughput/backpressure, saturation, regional failover, and Production capacity remain unknown.
layers.remediation: Approve quota, queue, latency, and cost ceilings, then run separately approved signed-user queue/fairness, backpressure, saturation, and dependency-failure exercises; do not infer Production capacity from the bounded liveness sample.

layers.name: Error tracking and logs
evidence: Content-free structured events, admin-only health/dependency routes, worker heartbeat state, audit-chain tests, and operator-alert queues exist. Candidate 1aded9c retains fail-closed alerting and value-blind environment-name controls. Exact Preview logs contained 16 allowlisted expected records with no content-bearing or unexpected record. Production has zero of eight operator-alerting names and zero of eight support-ownership names present; values were not read. Read-only account inspection found zero drains and one uninspected default team-wide alert rule, which is not delivery evidence.
layers.testCommand: npm run test:resilience && node scripts/job-agent-operator-alert-test.mjs && npm run test:preview-log-evidence
layers.failureDetails: No approved receiver, alert delivery receipt, retained log destination, dashboard SLO, or on-call acknowledgement was verified.
layers.remediation: Name owners and approve the exact destination, retention, and acknowledgement window; then verify receiver-side synthetic alert acknowledgement and any approved log retention/dashboard.

layers.name: Availability and recovery
evidence: Lease recovery, retries, circuit breaking, health endpoints, and encrypted-record recovery code pass local tests. Candidate 1aded9c adds a strict content-free managed-recovery evidence contract requiring distinct targets, the exact migration, encrypted backup policy, approved RPO/RTO and cost scope, zero cross-tenant/orphan findings, reconciliation, and cleanup. The isolated-data preflight still reports backupRestoreVerified=false and refuses to authorize restore or billable operations.
layers.testCommand: npm run test:resilience && node scripts/encrypted-record-recovery-test.mjs && npm run test:database-evidence
layers.failureDetails: Provider backup cadence/retention/PITR, isolated restore behavior, database integrity reconciliation, measured RPO/RTO, and alert delivery have not been verified.
layers.remediation: After the isolated target is proven and separate operator/cost approval is recorded, verify backup/PITR configuration, restore into a separate target, validate the redacted artifact, reconcile content-free counts and links, measure RPO/RTO, and retain signed evidence.
